announce.paragraph1: 'Strawberry Era' is my first ever movie and also my final assignment for my school. It's a documentary about today's youths being called as a 'strawberry generation'. This movie is 99% made by me. Even all of the soundtracks is made by me. Without using any A.I bullsh*t like Suno whatsoever.
announce.paragraph2: 'If we do not improve and better ourselves, we would truly be crushed like strawberries'
announce.paragraph3: This documentary explores the cultural meaning of negative generational labels commonly applied to young people, such as “the strawberry generation.” Drawing from a public survey conducted by media platforms in Taiwan, the film examines why young people strongly reject these labels and how such terms are produced and circulated through media discourse. Through interviews and everyday observations, the documentary contrasts stereotypical portrayals with the lived experiences of youth, questioning whether these labels reflect reality or reinforce misunderstanding. Ultimately, the film invites viewers to reconsider how language shapes generational identity and cultural perception.

about.paragraph1: Akhmad Zaky Maulana, born in 2008, is an Indonesian artist, musician, and photographer based in Bekasi. He is a graduate from SMK Al-Muhtadin majoring in Visual Communication Design.
about.paragraph2: Sometimes he locks himself in his room all day to create art that he hopes everyone will love. His interest in art started when he was 11 years old. His interest in art began when he started a small project making a Minecraft head avatar. The reason why he decided to pursue art because of his friend who can draw.
about.paragraph3: For his musical output, he uses various psudeonyms such as 'user12052008', 'Failed Human Being', and 'broktin' depending on the genre. His primary psudeonym that he currently use is 'broktin'. He has a strong adherence to making experimantal electronic music.
about.paragraph4: Started making music at 14, he is highly influenced by a British electronic musician Richard David James also known as Aphex Twin. Akhmad Zaky Maulana also influenced by other musician like Squarepusher, Autechre, Imaginary Softwoods, and Steve Hauschildt.
about.paragraph5: Photography is his favorite thing to do other than making music. He does not have a digital camera. So, he shoots everything on his phone. In his works, he shoots everything that he finds interesting. No wonder why his disk drives are always full of random photos. Sky, cloud, tall grass, and sun ray is his favorite subject to shoot. Because it's 'showing the peaceful side of Earth'.
about.paragraph6: Besides his interests in arts and music, he also interested in 'computers' and programming. Programming became his interest because of the COVID-19 pandemic. He really doesn't know what to do other than finishing his online school assignment. He learned HTML because he finds it easy to learn. His HTML project was just a simple biography website with a poorly designed CSS. Until now, HTML becoming useful for him to showcasing his art on this website.
